27.11.31

November 27, 1.

Sir,

I have to acknowledge receipt of your letter
No.382 of November 25, forwarding photographs of the
missing child named Zung Yoong Ling (陳永林) and
to inform you that the matter is receiving attention.

I am, Sir,

Your obedient servant,

Deputy Commissioner (Crime).

Colonel Chen Hsi Tseng,
Chief of the Public Safety Bureau,
Greater Shanghai Municipality.

逕复者昨
奉處十一月廿五号第八二二号大
函并附送失小孩陳永林小照一
纸函请通传查访等由现
已遵嘱办理去讫应复
希烦查照为荷此致
上海市公安局局长陈
刑事处处长安士

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.

Translation of letter from Shanghai Public Safety Bureau.

Lo 法 083                                      November 25, 1931.

Commissioner of Police,
I. M. P.
Shanghai.

Sir,

With reference to my previous letter
regarding a missing child named Chung Yung Ling
(陳永林) who was reported missing in the vicinity
of No. 6, Lane 946, Ward Road, Shanghai, on
4.11.31, his father has now forwarded copies of
photo of the child with a request to have them
circulated among all our districts as well as the
International Settlement and the French Concession.

I enclose herewith a photo of the missing
child and wish you will be good enough to have it
circulated among all your districts and offices.

Chen Hai Tseng,
Chief of Public Safety Bureau,
Shanghai.

Please issue circular with copy
of photo & description to all
stations.
27/11/31.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
总监办公室。

上海公安局来函译文。

Lo 法 083                                      1931年11月25日。

警务总监，
国际租界警务处，
上海。

先生：

关于我此前就一名叫陈永林（Chung Yung Ling）的失踪儿童所发信函，该儿童于1931年11月4日在上海华德路946弄6号附近报称失踪，其父现已寄来该儿童的照片副本，并要求将这些照片在我们所有辖区以及公共租界和法租界内 circulated（传阅/分发）。

现随函附上该失踪儿童照片一张，望阁下惠予安排在所有辖区及办事处内传阅。

陈希曾，
上海公安局局长，
上海。

请将附有照片及描述的通告发往各分局。
31年11月27日。

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. D. DEPARTMENT ...）

Translation of Letter from Shanghai Public Safety Bureau.

No. 841.                                      November 10, 1931.

Commissioner of Police,
S. M. P.
Shanghai.

Sir,

    I have to inform you that a complaint has been
made by Sung Chun Ming (陳俊明), a resident of No.3,
Lane 546, Manduria Road, Chepoi, as follows :-

    "My son named Sung Yoong Ling (陳永林), age 7
years, sturdy build, round face, wearing an underwear
with white stripes, a red woollen shirt, an old pink
coloured jacket, blue cotton pants and a pair of old
grey cotton shoes, was missing in the vicinity of the
above address at 5 p.m. of the 4th inst. A search has
been made without result, it is believed that my child
could not have gone far away but might have been kid-
napped. I, apart from inserting advertisements in the
"Sin Wan Pao" and "Tsun Pao" offering reward for the
recovery of the child, request you to cause enquiries
to be made in tracing the whereabouts of the child and
also to communicate with the Settlement and French
Police in the same respect."

    I shall be very grateful if you will kindly
cause the above information to be circulated among
the districts within your jurisdiction.

                                        Chen Hsi Tseng,
                                        Chief of Public Safety Bureau,
                                        Shanghai.

（批： circulated 11/11 ... 12/11/31）

上海公安局来函译文。

第 841 号。                                      1931年11月10日。

警务总监，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

先生：

    兹通知阁下，闸北曼杜里亚路546弄3号居民宋俊明（Sung Chun Ming，原文注：陈俊明）提出如下控告：-

    “吾子名宋永林（Sung Yoong Ling，原文注：陈永林），年七岁，体格健壮，圆脸，身穿白条纹内衣、红色羊毛衫、旧粉色夹克、蓝色棉裤及一双旧灰色棉鞋，于本月4日下午5时在上述地址附近失踪。经搜寻无果，深信吾儿未走远，但可能已被绑架。除在《新闻报》和《申报》刊登寻人启事并悬赏寻回孩子外，恳请阁下设法查询以追踪孩子下落，并就此事项与租界及法国警察当局联系。”

    如蒙阁下惠予将上述信息在贵管辖区域内各分局传阅，不胜感激。

                                        陈希曾，
                                        上海公安局局长，
                                        上海。

（批： circulated 11/11 ... 31年11月12日）
